title: Calibration circuit and stability gate for INT8/FP16 embedding profiles
creator: Miguel Santos
description: Goal: Implement an automated calibration circuit and runtime gate to validate and block (circuit-break) deployment of INT8 and FP16 embedding quantization profiles when embedding similarity quality degrades beyond acceptable bounds. This ticket covers the calibration job orchestration, synthetic perturbation tests, holdout evaluation, and the integration of a cosine-stability gate into the rollout pipeline for embedding models. The approach emphasizes reproducible calibration runs, per-corpus baselines, and clear, actionable signals for rollouts and emergency fallback to FP32/FP16 profiles.
tasks: Design calibration circuit: schedule, inputs, outputs, artifacts (quant tables, scale/zero params)
Implement calibration job that runs: per-shard sampling, per-layer statistics, per-embedding quant noise estimation
Add synthetic perturbation harness to generate adversarial/edge queries to stress similarity (short prompts, heavy stopwords, multilingual)
Define holdout protocol: 5 holdout corpora (semantic-search, recommendations, dedup, multilingual-recall, paraphrase) with seeded splits
Compute stability signals: baseline cosine distribution, mean drop, p95 drop, recall@1/5/10 regression, and embedding L2 dispersion
Create a rollout gate service that evaluates artifacts from calibration job and emits PASS/WARN/FAIL with reasons
Wire gate to rollout orchestration: prevent canary promotion on FAIL, allow automatic rollback and fallback profile selection on WARN
Instrument console dashboards: per-profile comparison, time-series of cosine_mean_delta, cohort recall regressions
Add automated nightly recalibration job and retention for last 14 calibrations for historical comparison
Write PRD and runbook for on-call to triage gating failures and trigger manual re-calibration
acceptance_criteria: Calibration job produces repeatable quant artifacts and scalar metrics for INT8 and FP16 profiles for the anchor model
Rollout gate evaluates calibration output and returns PASS/WARN/FAIL deterministically against configured thresholds
Automated synthetic perturbation tests detect at least 2 classes of failure modes in the staging profile runs
Console shows per-run cosine_baseline_mean, cosine_candidate_mean, cosine_mean_delta, and recall@k deltas visible to PM/SE
If gate returns FAIL during canary, the promotion is blocked and system automatically falls back to pre-calibration profile
Nightly recalibration runs and stores artifacts; historical comparisons can be computed on-demand via the console
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): run calibration circuit for model-anchor in staging buckets and validate metrics manually
Phase 2 (canary): enable gate for 5% of production traffic with automatic rollback on FAIL
Phase 3 (ramp): increment canary to 25% after 72h PASS, then 100% after 7 days if stable
Emergency path: immediate fallback to FP16/FP32 profile and alerting to SRE/ML leads
monitoring_signals: recall_at_1_delta: relative drop compared to baseline (alert if > 3%)
embedding_l2_std_change: increase in per-dimension stddev (indicator of quant noise)
anomaly_rate: fraction of queries in canary with similarity < baseline - 0.05
comments: 2025-03-05 Miguel Santos: Created ticket. Initial design brainstorming with ML infra and SRE. Decided to keep per-corpus baselines instead of single global baseline due to corpus heterogeneity.

2025-03-07 Elena Park: Implemented prototype calibration job; discovered that naive min-max scaling produces large layerwise bias in INT8 for small-batch sequences. Plan to switch to per-channel symmetric calibration with outlier clipping.

2025-03-09 Priya Reddy (ML Eng): Synthetic perturbation harness caught a regression on short, punctuation-heavy queries where cosine dropped by 0.035. Added additional holdout corpus for short-query patterns.
2025-03-10 SRE review: Recommended circuit-breaker semantics be idempotent and include a TTL for WARN states to allow transient noise without full block. Added auto-recheck after 30 minutes.

2025-03-12 Elena Park: Gate prototype returns PASS/WARN/FAIL. Current thresholds are conservative; PM to review acceptable delta budget. Next: integrate into runtime canary pipeline and add dashboard tiles.
Follow-ups: schedule PM review of threshold policy (PM: Jonah Kim), add UX copy for rollback reason in Console, run 3 full calibrations on production sample before canary launch.
